name: Apogee
blurb: A Mac browser that blocks every ad, cleans up YouTube and answers your questions on a drawn board.

name: Wire Choir
blurb: Type a line and glowing heads sing it, every tongue and jaw movement driven by a real model of the human throat.

name: Gzowo StarNet
blurb: Every project on this site hangs in one net. Pick what you like and everything that does not fit drops out.

name: Beam
blurb: Projection mapping as a game: trace the frames and shelves on your wall, then run and jump across them in neon.

name: Odd Herd
blurb: A pixel art co-op platformer for 1 to 4 players online: pick one of ten animals and get the whole herd through the door.

name: Ghostbusters
blurb: Suit up at the Ecto-1 with up to three friends, blast a greedy ghost, wrangle it together and drag it into a trap.

name: Instalator
blurb: Kit out real houses with real smart home gear: the TV shows a dollhouse, your phones are the tools.

name: Rybna Wyspa
blurb: Build a fish farm with friends on a small island in the Narew: pumps, belts, flumes, machines and a riverside fish fry.

name: Stillvale
blurb: A quiet walk through an alpine valley: tall grass, a still lake and birdsong. Keep an eye on the timer.

name: Robotea
blurb: Your webcam turns your hands into a robot's hands: high-five another robot, or make finger guns and hit the range.

name: Ghostframe
blurb: Pose see-through ghosts of Tesla Optimus around a stage and watch it walk and jump through every in-between frame.

name: Rug Rush
blurb: Unload rug trucks, read the care labels and wash every rug in a co-op warehouse without ruining the silk.

name: Fabrics
blurb: Pull curtains, fly flags, drape robes and scrunch rugs, then cut, burn, dye and blow on real-time cloth.

name: Roadster Jump
blurb: Suction the Roadster up a giant curled ramp, hang from the ceiling, then kickflip off the lip on cold-gas jets.

name: Spillway
blurb: Draw gutters with a limited marker and pump your colour of water into its cup, alone or with up to three friends online.

name: Mirage
blurb: Put on smart glasses, call drones down from orbit and project a dragon, a whale or outer space over Venice.

name: Timeblock
blurb: Drop in a video and it turns into a block of time cast in sanded resin, where every frame is a slice.

name: Speak & Groove
blurb: Type a letter and a robot voice spells it through a big reverb, then a techno band joins in behind you.

name: Toot Tube
blurb: Up to three animals hang on to one inflatable ring and steer it down a spiky river the only way they can: by farting.

name: Cutlery
blurb: Fork, Knife and Butter find their way back to the breakfast table, each one a tool the others need.

name: Kindling
blurb: Stick monsters crawl out of a cornfield. Cut them apart with a laser, jump the iron wall and feed the fire.

name: Campfire
blurb: Sit by a campfire in a dark forest: stack logs, stir the embers, toast a marshmallow or put it all out.

name: Cube Breakers
blurb: Shoot balls that bounce forever into a giant cube of blocks, together with everyone who is online.

name: Roadster 88
blurb: Drive, boost and fly the 2026 Tesla Roadster on ten cold-gas thrusters, then hit 88 mph and jump through time.

name: Wolisz?!
blurb: A 2D online sandbox where every would-you-rather question gives your avatar a power, and the powers pile up.

name: Make Your Own Game, I'm Lazy
blurb: Draw a tree, a hero and a gun, say what game you want, and an AI writes it around your drawings.

name: Foamwalker
blurb: A hunched purple alien with a human face crawls through a foam-block maze.

name: iPhone Duo
blurb: A semi-realistic virtual clone of the iPhone Duo

name: Wordshader
blurb: Type a line of words and watch a glowing 3D blob and its soundtrack appear letter by letter, then export the loop as a video.

name: Timberline Express
blurb: Survive an endless mountain forest by turning a hand-pumped rail cart into a steam-powered, house-sized train.

name: Haystack Inc.
blurb: Somewhere in a stack of a million straws there is one needle. Dig by hand, then build the machines that dig for you.

name: Hello Miner
blurb: Program mining drones in a tiny Python-like language and automate a floating quarry together with friends in real time.

name: Gzowo Glass
blurb: Home-built smart glasses with a see-through HUD and a voice assistant that talks back in Polish.

name: Squish
blurb: A silent paper-white void full of squishies and fidget toys you can actually squeeze, crack and stretch.

name: Doodle Run
blurb: A 2D runner where you draw every single thing in it first, then rig your scribbles so they walk, flap and chase you.

name: Smendilendi Bureau
blurb: Run a tiny architecture practice with your friends, draw the walls, take the client's notes, then walk the finished building thirty years later.

name: Mark Zero
blurb: Fly a powered armor suit at the speed of sound, six degrees of freedom, no rails, no limits.

name: Noclip
blurb: A found-footage Backrooms experience, you fall in, something tall follows, and the tape keeps rolling.

name: Voidworks
blurb: A factory hanging in white nothing. Droppers, belts, upgraders, and a hard cap on how much can be moving at once.

name: Ducks
blurb: Feed rubber ducks to a hungry pit, then build the machines that do it for you.

name: G-Doodle
blurb: A transformer that draws. Type what you want in Polish and it sketches it stroke by stroke.

name: Hollowtree
blurb: One to three players, each of them a queen bee, sharing one hive inside a hollow tree.

name: Narew Labs
blurb: Chat with a language model trained from scratch, running on a MacBook, reached from anywhere.

name: SKI Together
blurb: A day at a ski resort for two to five people, on snow that remembers every turn you carved.

name: Smendiłendi
blurb: A printed robot dog on four servos and an ESP32, the first project here whose output is a physical object.

name: Gzowo Builders
blurb: Build a vehicle out of blocks, wheels and pistons, then drive it until something snaps off.

name: G-Mini
blurb: The second rung of the ladder: 178 million parameters, warm-started from G-Micro, trained in one week of free GPU time.

name: Gzowo TV
blurb: An Apple TV for the family plot, every streaming service in one launcher, on a Mac plugged into the television.

name: Airwave
blurb: An instrument you play with your hands in the air, in front of a webcam. No hardware.

name: Voxel Demolition
blurb: A destruction sandbox with twenty-five tools and co-op for four. Runs on a server at home.

name: G-Images
blurb: A diffusion model for editing photos, trained from scratch, small enough to run on a laptop.

name: G-Micro
blurb: A 117-million-parameter language model in Polish, trained from scratch, tokenizer, corpus and training loop included.

name: MJJ Archives
blurb: Watch Billie Jean at Motown 25 rebuilt in 3D, together, with the television cuts replayed shot for shot.

name: Untitled Civ Game
blurb: One to three gods share a single city and take down a rival built by the machine.

name: Gargantua
blurb: Co-op zero-gravity spacewalk next to a black hole. Push off carefully; there is no brake.

name: Cruise Control
blurb: A precision driving game with retro pixel post-processing, moving hazards and a shop.

name: Untitled Pogo Game
blurb: Fifteen levels of pogo-stick parkour, playable together, installable as an app.

name: Backrooms
blurb: Yellow rooms, buzzing lights, and a maze that does not care whether you get out.

name: Gzowo AI
blurb: A voice assistant for the house in Gzowo, speak to it in Polish and it answers in real time.

name: GSP Brand Kit
blurb: The visual identity behind GSP, logo, colours and type, in one page you can download from.

name: Gzowo Bowling
blurb: Bowling on a laptop, thrown with a phone. Scan the code and your phone becomes the ball.

name: Modular
blurb: Drop sixteen kinds of building on a plot and watch a town assemble itself around them.

name: Galeria Gzowo
blurb: A gallery for the place the rest of this site is named after.

name: Narew
blurb: One real property by the Narew: paddle it, dig it, ride a jet ski through it, or watch TV indoors.
